description: Build a Permissions-Policy response-header value from a list of browser features (e.g. camera, microphone, geolocation) and their per-feature allowlist ("self", specific origins, "*" for all origins, or an empty allowlist to disable the feature entirely), attaching a plain-English note on what each feature restricts.

features.description: Features and their allowlists to include in the header

allowlist.description: Origins allowed to use the feature: "self", "*" for all origins, specific https:// origins, or an empty array to disable it entirely

name: build_permissions_policy
